_ai.what: Prism Deck catalog: Stream Deck (and Corsair Galleon) artwork rendered as deterministic SVG — glyphs × themes on keys, spans of keys (including the physical gaps), touch strips, screens and whole devices — by the zero-dependency prism-deck engine.
_ai.howToUse: Pick a facet by gallery/category/surface/tags. In the Stream Deck app use the Prism Deck plugin (`usage.plugin`). In code, render(facet, { device, theme, t, state, params }) returns { svg, keys?, segments?, widgets?, screen? } — whole-canvas SVG plus the per-key / per-dial slices the hardware takes. Offline: every module of the package is in top-level `sources` (keys "prism-deck/src/…"); import `sources["prism-deck/src/web/island.js"]` as a blob: module and call loadIsland(catalog) to run facets with no network. Output is deterministic for (t, state, params, seed, theme).

fields.surface: key (native key px) | span (block of keys incl. gaps) | strip (Stream Deck + touch strip or one 200×100 dial segment) | screen (Galleon 720×384, Neo info bar 232×50) | deck (whole panel)
fields.span: span: default block { cols, rows } (numbers or "all")
fields.theme: themes gallery: the theme previewed (other facets follow the deck theme)
fields.still: the thumbnail instant in seconds (facet.still, else min(loop × 0.4, 6))
fields.data: live inputs a runtime may feed (ctx.data) — facets simulate fallbacks
fields.dataShape: optional: the shape of each ctx.data key the facet reads
fields.targets: the sizes / devices / screens it renders at (conformance matrix)
fields.module: the facet's ES module; also its key in `sources`
fields.imports: import specifiers in the module (all resolvable inside `sources`)
fields.game: stateful facets (API 1.5): { tickHz, animate, reset } — play them through scene/game.js createGameHost (the web player and the hid runner do it for you); null for stateless facets
fields.preview: static frame { w, h, t, svg }

_ai.sources: top-level `sources`: { "prism-deck/src/<path>": "<ES module source>" } for every browser-safe module of the package (engine, scene, fonts, devices, themes, glyphs, facets, raster, web), closed under relative imports. Node-only parts (plugin runtime, HID, audio capture, exporters) ship in the npm package only.

themes.title: Aurora
themes.description: Frosted keys with the northern lights behind them: soft curtains that rise and flow in the hue when on, lines of light through etched frost, a press that fogs the glass.

themes.title: Blueprint
themes.description: White linework on a Prussian-blue drafting grid (deep blue on whiteprint by day): hatched sections, dashed hidden lines, every glyph dimensioned, a plotter that redraws on press.

themes.title: Chrome
themes.description: Machined metal: chamfered keys with brushed faces, polished chrome glyphs, engraved detail and LEDs set in milled channels. Black chrome by night, satin aluminum by day.

themes.title: Ember
themes.description: Warm dark: coals and amber light. Glyphs are live embers with a char crust and glowing cracks; heat is the state, a press works the bellows and throws sparks.

themes.title: Mono
themes.description: Maximal contrast for low vision and bright rooms: pure black and white, AAA text, heavy frames, reversed labels for on, shape-coded alerts, ghosted disabled keys, bold type.

themes.title: Neon
themes.description: Glass tubes on black: glyphs glow as gas-filled neon with white-hot cores; tubes switch rather than fade, alerts buzz, and a press re-strikes the gas.

themes.title: Paper
themes.description: Ink on warm cotton paper: letterpress cards with impressed glyphs, a spot color printed off register, halftone screens for on, dog-eared alerts. By night, white ink and foil on black card.

themes.title: Phosphor
themes.description: Green CRT keys: beam-drawn lines in a phosphor bloom, whole-pixel scanlines, persistence trails on anything that moves, a raster that blooms on press.

themes.title: Pixel
themes.description: 8-bit LCD keys: glyphs on a whole-pixel dot matrix, dithered light from below, bitmap type, and a press that drops the face one pixel.

themes.title: Porcelain
themes.description: Glossy white ceramic tiles painted in cobalt: underglaze brushwork, raised enamel when lit, china bands and gold luster. By night, cobalt-glazed porcelain with white slip.

themes.title: Prism
themes.description: Refraction: ink-navy glass lit from the top (pearl by day), a spectral index on every key, rings and washes of light for on and alert, presses that refract.

galleries.title: Themes
galleries.blurb: One facet per deck theme: the whole device dressed in that material — every glyph, label, state and press.

galleries.title: Icons
galleries.blurb: One facet per glyph — 48-unit geometry with states and idle motion, rendered in any theme.

galleries.title: Motion
galleries.blurb: Key animations built for the hardware: press feedback, state transitions, idle loops and alerts.

galleries.title: Spans
galleries.blurb: Animations across blocks of keys — the physical gaps are hidden pixels, so motion reads continuous behind the bezel; deck walls carry on across the + strip and the Galleon screen.

galleries.title: Dials & Strips
galleries.blurb: Stream Deck + / + XL encoders: 200×100 dial segments and full touch-strip panoramas.

galleries.title: Screens
galleries.blurb: Display widgets: the Galleon 100 SD screen, the Neo info bar and Stream Deck + strip dashboards.

galleries.title: Apps
galleries.blurb: Live apps composed from the above plus data sources: audio, system, clocks and timers, controls (meeting, scene and media keys), dashboards.

galleries.title: Games
galleries.blurb: Games and toys played on the keys: puzzles across a block of keys, chance and reflex games on one — stateful facets (scene/game.js).

facets.title: Prism
facets.description: Refraction on hardware: ink-navy glass keys lit from inside, the spectral Beam on every key that is on, pressed keys refracting.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Prism
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-prism'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-prism', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Phosphor
facets.description: Green CRT keys: beam-drawn glyphs in a phosphor bloom, whole-pixel scanlines and persistence trails; by day, reverse video.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Phosphor
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-phosphor'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'phosphor', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-phosphor', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Mono
facets.description: Accessibility first: pure black and white at 21:1, AAA text, bold type, heavy frames and reversed labels for on, shape-coded alerts and gray off keys. Day for bright rooms.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Mono
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-mono'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'mono', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-mono', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Neon
facets.description: Glass tubes on black: every glyph bent from gas-filled neon with a white-hot core; tubes switch, alerts buzz, a press re-strikes the gas. By day, a sign on whitewashed brick.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Neon
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-neon'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'neon', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-neon', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Ember
facets.description: Warm dark: a cast-iron firebox where glyphs are live embers with glowing cracks, heat is the state language and a press throws sparks. By day, pyrography on birch.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Ember
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-ember'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'ember', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-ember', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Aurora
facets.description: Frosted keys over the northern lights: curtains rise and flow in each key’s hue when it turns on, light shines through etched frost, a press fogs the glass. By day, opal.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Aurora
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-aurora'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'aurora', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-aurora', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Chrome
facets.description: Machined metal: chamfered keys with brushed faces, polished chrome glyphs and LEDs set in milled channels; a press travels in and springs back. By day, satin aluminum.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Chrome
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-chrome'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'chrome', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-chrome', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Paper
facets.description: Letterpress on warm cotton stock: impressed glyphs, a spot color off register, halftone for on, dog-eared alerts, proof-gray off keys. By night, white ink and foil on black card.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Paper
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-paper'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'paper', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-paper', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Porcelain
facets.description: Glossy white ceramic tiles painted in cobalt: underglaze brushwork, raised enamel and china bands when lit, gold luster, a press that rings. By night, cobalt glaze.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Porcelain
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-porcelain'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'porcelain', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-porcelain', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Pixel
facets.description: 8-bit LCD keys: glyphs on a whole-pixel dot matrix, dithered light from below, bitmap type, and presses that drop the face one pixel.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Pixel
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-pixel'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'pixel', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'theme-pixel', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Blueprint
facets.description: White linework on a blue drafting grid: hatched sections, dashed hidden lines, every glyph dimensioned, a plotter that redraws on press. By day, a whiteprint.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Blueprint
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('theme-blueprint'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'blueprint', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';

facets.title: Clock Across Keys
facets.description: The time across a row of keys, one digit per key: changing digits refract into place, the colon blinks, a Beam sweeps the row once a minute.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Clock Across Keys
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-clock'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-clock', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Split-Flap Clock
facets.description: A split-flap clock across a row of keys: each digit is a flap unit whose top card falls with gravity, passes the hinge and bounces when the time changes.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Split-Flap Clock
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-flip-clock'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-flip-clock', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Chat Ticker
facets.description: Chat across a row of keys: the speaker on the first key, the message flowing word by word through the rest — never cut by a bezel. Mentions light up.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Chat Ticker
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-chat-ticker'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-chat-ticker', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Scoreboard
facets.description: Two teams on split-flap cards across a row: tap a team to score, hold half a second to take one back, first-to target lights the winner.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Scoreboard
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-scoreboard'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-scoreboard', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Digital Rain
facets.description: Streams of mirrored glyphs fall down every column of keys: white-hot heads, fading trails, mutating characters, rows that continue behind the bezels.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Digital Rain
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-digital-rain'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-digital-rain', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Ripple
facets.description: Press a key and a ring of light spreads from it across the device, splitting into the Spectrum and lighting each key it crosses; idle, drops fall like rain on a pond.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Ripple
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-ripple'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-ripple', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Spectral Rain
facets.description: Streaks of colored light rain down the whole device, falling through the rows behind the bezels and splashing in the bottom row; calm, sparse and seamless.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Spectral Rain
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-rain'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-rain', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Fireflies
facets.description: A summer night across the device: fireflies drift and blink above the grass on the bottom row; press a key and the swarm falls into step, flashing together.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Fireflies
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-fireflies'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-fireflies', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Constellations
facets.description: Constellations draw themselves across the device: stars brighten, a hairline of light joins them across the bezels, the name appears, then the next figure begins.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Constellations
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';

usage.web:

mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-constellation', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Rain on Glass

facets.title: Dispersion
facets.description: The whole device as a window onto one glass prism: a white beam enters, bends and fans out as the Spectrum, sweeping slowly across every key and lighting each in its color.

usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-dispersion'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-dispersion', resolve: findFacet });

mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-aurora', resolve: findFacet });

import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-life'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }

import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-life', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Aquarium
facets.description: A fish tank across the device: fish glide behind the bezels from key to key over sand and swaying weed; press a key to drop food and the fish gather there.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Aquarium
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-aquarium'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-aquarium', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Hearth
facets.description: A fire in the hearth across the whole device: logs on the bottom row, flames climbing through the bezel into the keys above, sparks drifting up, warm light on the brick.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Hearth
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-hearth'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-hearth', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Snowfall
facets.description: Snow falls across the device in three depths and settles on the bottom row; the drift deepens through the minute until a gust lifts it off in a glittering spray.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Snowfall
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-snowfall'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:

mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-snowfall', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Warp
facets.description: Stars stream out of a vanishing point at the middle of the device: a calm cruise, the drive spools up, streaks split into the Spectrum, a white flash, then cruise again.

facets.title: Ocean Swell
facets.description: The open sea across the device: a horizon through the upper keys, long swells rolling toward you, a glitter path under the low sun by day or the moon by night.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Ocean Swell
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-swell'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-swell', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Galaxy
facets.description: A spiral galaxy turning slowly across the device: a warm core mid-deck, blue-white arms beaded with rose knots winding through every key; a star-atlas engraving by day.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Galaxy
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-galaxy'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-galaxy', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Daylight
facets.description: A window on the day, driven by the clock: the sun arcs across the device, the sky runs dawn, midday, golden hour and a starry night; a house on the hill lights up.

source.label: Time (clock or a day per loop)

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Daylight
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('span-daylight'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'span-daylight', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Volume Dial
facets.description: Turn to set a level, push to mute: a spectral Beam with the signal beneath. Pick output or mic; it shows the level only (no system volume control yet).

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Volume Dial (on a dial)
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('dial-volume'), { device: 'plus', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'plus', dials: ['dial-volume'], resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Volume Arc
facets.description: A 270° spectral arc that follows every detent, with a dB readout and the signal inside. Push or tap to mute. Output or mic; shows the level only.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Volume Arc (on a dial)
usage.code:

mountDevice(el, { model: 'plus', dials: ['dial-volume-arc'], resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Value Bars
facets.description: A stepped wedge of 20 bars: one detent lights one bar, the lead bar fills for finer steps. Push or tap to switch off; the bars drain and stand hollow.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Value Bars (on a dial)
usage.code:

facets.title: Key Light
facets.description: A key light on one dial: turn for brightness and the panel glows brighter in its own color temperature; push to switch it off and on.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Key Light (on a dial)

facets.description: Zoom on a dial: each detent is an even step on a log scale from 10 % to 800 %, a minimap frames the viewport, push to fit. Hold the strip to return to 100 %.

facets.title: Meeting Camera
facets.description: Your camera in a call: on with an on-air tally, off in red. Shows state only (it does not switch your camera); linked camera keys follow.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Meeting Camera
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('app-meeting-camera'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', keys: ['app-meeting-camera'], resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Merge
facets.description: Slide numbered tiles with dials, arrow keys or the board edges; equal tiles fuse and double. Reach 2048 as the tiles cool from violet to rose, then turn to light.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Merge
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('game-merge'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'game-merge', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Memory
facets.description: Pairs of pieces hidden across every key: flip two at a time, they refract into view; match them all in as few moves as you can. The screen or strip keeps score.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Memory
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('game-memory'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'game-memory', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Spectrum
facets.description: Every key holds a color from the Spectrum, shuffled; swap keys two at a time until the light runs rose to violet. Each key reads its λ, so it plays in any theme.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Spectrum
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('game-spectrum'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'game-spectrum', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Dice
facets.description: Press to roll one or two dice: they tumble, hop and land on the result, drawn in the deck theme. Seeded, so the same game replays the same rolls.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Dice
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('game-dice'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', keys: ['game-dice'], resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Coin Flip
facets.description: Flip a coin on one key: it leaps, spins edge-on and lands sun (heads) or moon (tails), keeping the streak and the tally. Seeded, so a game replays the same flips.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Coin Flip
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('game-coin'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', keys: ['game-coin'], resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Slots
facets.description: A three-reel slot machine across three keys: press to spin, the reels stop one by one; three of a kind pays and three prisms are the jackpot. Seeded, never real money.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Slots
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('game-slots'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'game-slots', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Oracle
facets.description: Ask a yes-or-no question and press: the old answer disperses, a beam crosses the key and the new one refracts into focus, jade for yes, citrine for maybe, rose for no.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Oracle
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('game-oracle'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:
import { mountDevice } from 'prism-deck/web';
mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', keys: ['game-oracle'], resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Echo
facets.description: The light plays a sequence across spectral pads, each with its own hue, shape and λ; play it back. Every round adds a note and the pace picks up.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Echo
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('game-echo'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }
usage.web:

mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', facet: 'game-echo', resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Catch the Light
facets.description: Sparks of light land on random keys: press each before its ring closes. Rounds speed up as they go; a rare prism is worth three and streaks build a combo.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Catch the Light
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';
const frame = render(findFacet('game-catch'), { device: 'mk2', theme: 'prism', t: 1.5 }); // { svg, keys?, segments?, … }

facets.title: Reaction
facets.description: Press to arm, wait in the dark, and hit the key the instant the beam strikes: it shows your reaction time in ms and keeps your best. Jump early and it is a false start.

usage.plugin: Stream Deck app → Prism Deck → "Prism Display" → Reaction
usage.code:
import { render, findFacet } from 'prism-deck';

mountDevice(el, { model: 'mk2', keys: ['game-reaction'], resolve: findFacet });

facets.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
facets.description: Noughts and crosses on any 3 × 3 block of keys against Prism, a small opponent with three levels. A win beams down the line; the Galleon screen keeps score.
